full-width provider cards; per-row dual quota reading (compact ring + horizontal bar) each status-coloured independently; leading gauge / brand-glyph+name / trailing plan pill; second line label+bar+bold %
dashboard stat tiles (WEEKLY/SONNET/UNDER-PACE) — tracked-caps label + glyph + bold value + thin progress bar + reset caption; ~12px radius warm-charcoal fill

signature_moves: The meter IS the metaphor: a pixel/bitmap display face on the wordmark + every numeral, wrapped in dial gauges and a green/amber/red traffic-light ramp — the app costumes itself as a physical usage instrument (subject-mining 'meter' fully committed).
Dual-window provider card: ring (one window) + bar (another window) per row, each independently threshold-coloured, so the one at-risk provider pops pre-attentively from a green field.
Tracked-caps mono labels as systematic house style (deviates from native sentence-case type grammar but committed across all surfaces — signature-with-caveat, not defect).
defects: Contrast Dilution (non-text, #10) — unfilled ring/bar tracks and card borders <3:1 on #1E1E1E; conventional dark-gauge styling but strict WCAG non-text-contrast fail

Accent split (contested/low-confidence) — status green/amber/red on live surfaces vs a single terracotta-orange brand accent on widget+history; same 42% reads green (dashboard) and orange (widget); may be per-surface theming or genuine inconsistency, unsettleable from a marketing composite
Bordered icon buttons (native#9) — dashboard footer icon buttons carry visible rounded-rect borders vs the borderless-monochrome-SF-Symbol toolbar norm

aesthetic.direction: Terminal/hacker family (mono, dark, pixel display font) fused with a dashboard/instrument-panel register — a developer-tool dark theme whose numerals are LCD-style pixel readouts

psychology: Von Restorff / signal-detection — green/amber/red status makes the single at-risk provider (red 96%) the pre-attentive standout in a green list; the one different thing is remembered
Zeigarnik + Goal-gradient — progress rings, 'Resets in Xh/Xd', and burn-rate alerts exploit task-incompleteness/urgency to prompt pacing
Doherty / feedback — live refresh countdowns (00:04, 16:06) give constant low-latency feedback that the meter is current
Aesthetic-Usability — the fully committed instrument aesthetic buys a perceived-quality halo for a data-dense utility
Jakob's Law — familiar gauge/progress metaphors + genuinely native Notification Center banners make a novel product instantly legible
Hick's Law (respected) — the provider list is a scan/browse surface (option density is a feature there), not a decision point, so its density is appropriate not overloaded
notes: cover.png is a marketing composite: four app panels floated on a dark warm-amber radial backdrop (backdrop = brand evidence, panels = design evidence). Panels are enlarged and two are perspective-tilted, so ALL pixel sizes are estimated with wide ranges — proportions/colours trustworthy, absolute pt are not; retina scale indeterminate. Lineage native@med: SF-Symbol footer glyphs, OS-native notification banners, and #1E1E1E kit-exact ground read AppKit/SwiftUI, but a Tauri/Electron shell reusing SF Symbols + real macOS notifications cannot be excluded from a still — confirm with a real @2x screengrab. Heavy bespoke theming means most distinctive choices are house-style, not learnable mac canon. No light mode, no settings surface seen. First candidate member of a terminal-instrument-dark menu-bar cluster (needs >=2 more to promote a cluster identity). icon.png present but NOT digested — task scoped to Workflow A (UI) only; leave for Workflow B.
